content.title: Inflationary spacetimes are not past-complete
content.author: Arvind Borde, Alan H. Guth and Alexander Vilenkin (Physical Review Letters 90, 151301, 2003)
content.note: The physics result usually called the Borde–Guth–Vilenkin theorem: a spacetime that is, on average, expanding along its past geodesics cannot be extended infinitely into the past, so inflation needs other physics to describe its beginning. The authors draw no theological conclusion. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
